scope: Phase 2 repository-context retrieval through Aura Agent Bridge plus Selective Architect Fusion Council V3 planning calls

full_codex_session_provider_telemetry.note: The Codex task does not expose provider-reported whole-session input/output totals. The proxy totals below cover the instrumented Bridge and Council scopes only and must not be represented as billing telemetry.

agent_bridge.objective: Implement Aura Gate Phase 2 as a canonical, purpose-bound governance wrapper around Aura Forge using OIDC identity, policy and expiring capability leases, purpose-limited MCP/A2A egress, SHADOW and PAIRED_LIVE comparisons, append-only audit/SIEM projection, and a hardened private deployment while preserving exact evidence and human authority.
agent_bridge.command: python -m aura_agent_arena_cli token-report --objective "Implement Aura Gate Phase 2 as a canonical, purpose-bound governance wrapper around Aura Forge using OIDC identity, policy and expiring capability leases, purpose-limited MCP/A2A egress, SHADOW and PAIRED_LIVE comparisons, append-only audit/SIEM projection, and a hardened private deployment while preserving exact evidence and human authority." --files aura_forge.py,aura_gate.py,aura_gate_oidc.py,aura_gate_audit.py,aura_gate_egress.py,aura_gate_comparison.py --format json

historical_planning_snapshot.reason: The first planning measurement was captured before the Phase 2 files reached their final sizes and did not record per-file hashes. It is preserved as historical planning evidence, not presented as a current-tree measurement.

agent_bridge.heuristic_basis: The 300/750/1200/500 token components are configured Arena-mode budgets from aura_hermes_arena_mode.py, not provider-observed payload telemetry.
agent_bridge.note: Counterfactual compares reading all selected files in full with modeled Bridge digest/search/slice/micro budgets.

current_tree_reference_after_adversarial.note: This reference makes the later tree size auditable. It is not substituted into the historical combined estimate because the Bridge interaction occurred against the earlier planning snapshot.

selective_council_v3.note: V3 selected four critic lanes for the thin alternative and skipped continuity and cost. The counterfactual adds those two prompts and estimates their outputs from observed critic output size; it conservatively excludes any larger downstream judge prompt.

combined_non_overlapping_proxy.formula: Bridge context proxy + Council call proxy; savings are the raw-read Bridge counterfactual plus the uniform-six-lane Council counterfactual.
combined_non_overlapping_proxy.warning: This is a reproducible engineering estimate for the instrumented scopes, not provider billing or a whole-session token total.
